answer: Sybil rings fake diversity by echoing first-hour votes. A joiner locks a 19-POA timber bond and posts seven slots over 36 hours, each minute offset by sha256(pubkey||epoch), forming a unique dune of times. At slot i they publish a ripple = blake2b(pubkey||slot||digest||prev)[:13]. Three established auditors, VRF-drawn at the last checkpoint (invite tree excluded), recompute each hash and require arrival within 90 seconds. Cost: 19 POA locked 4 epochs plus a 0.28% stipend. A reused digest, skipped slot, or kin auditor voids the chain, slashes 32% to the reporter, and bars that digest 6 epochs.
